How it got there

Take the perturbation away again

Round-24 policies re-evaluated with the knee unlocked, the rope untied, the pack off. Knee and rope keep walking; the backpack policy does not — it specialised to carrying 8 kg.

Round-24 policywith perturbationremovedΔtracking err removed
Locked knee10/107/10−30.280 m/s
Rope on the ankle9/109/1000.187 m/s
8 kg backpack10/103/10−70.294 m/s

Read this with the confound in mind

The confound
The starting checkpoint is a fixed-command prior trained in IsaacSim, and it does not transfer: 15/16 in Isaac, 0/10 in MuJoCo with no perturbation at all. These curves mix recovery from the sim-to-sim gap with adaptation to the perturbation. An unperturbed control run is the missing piece.
Sim is generous
The locked knee survives 9/10 here; on the physical robot the same task terminated 46 of 52 episodes in its first round. Read these as ordering, not as hardware predictions.
Held fixed
One PPO core, one five-term reward, holosoma joint dynamics, self-collision off, dt 0.005 × 4, 16 envs, command (0.4, 0, 0), learner at Stage-III defaults and untuned.
Reward term breakdown

The 8 kg pack starts at half the per-step reward of the locked knee and ends within 6 % of it. The alive term is a constant 0.0200 per surviving step, so it enters only through episode length.
